name: q8_w4_quadratic_t3_learned_read_3000
purpose: Reader-only intervention: learned periodic probe priors, dimension-scaled QK logits, and equal initial query contributions.
initialization_bath_reference: unified; common parameters copied by construction, only bath replaced
execution: compiled operators + captured forward/backward + Triton Givens and exact rank-four basis application
state_policy: one persistent field and posterior precision, carried over every chunk and update
comparison_reference: q8_w4_quadratic_t3_k16_3000; preserve writer, transport, collision, bath, T/K, dataset, optimizer and evaluation.
primary_outcome: held-out site NLL at matched optimizer update/data budget
mechanistic_outcome: site-averaged total energy decomposed into DC and spatial energy at training snapshots and held-out site terminal states
stopping: 3000 jointly trained optimizer updates, or surfaced numerical failure; record learning curves and convergence evidence before further claims
predictions: Probe coordinates and each query must receive finite nonzero CE gradients from initialization.
Reader-only benefit is assessed by matched 3000-update joint OWT curves and warm-local validation; entropy reduction is a diagnostic, not a task objective.

readout_initialization.periodic_position_scale: sqrt(6), unit spatial-logit variance on a uniform torus
readout_initialization.probe_layout: balanced 4x2x2 cell centers; learned in continuous periodic coordinates
readout_initialization.query_merge: equal 1/Q physical means initially; subsequently learned
readout_initialization.head_specialization: learned freely; no imposed diversity penalty
